name: PipeClubSession
description: A recorded Pipe Club / tasting session. Designed to be extensible for future cigar-club and whiskey-tasting session types via session_type.

date.description: Date and time of the session (ISO 8601)

club_name.description: Optional name of the pipe club or meeting group

location.description: Optional location where the meeting took place

pipes_present.description: JSON array of pipes/bowls physically present at the meeting: [{pipe_id, pipe_name, maker, bowl_variant_id, bowl_name}]

proposed_blend_id.description: ID of an owned TobaccoBlend, if the club tobacco comes from the user's collection

proposed_blend_name.description: Display name of the proposed/shared tobacco blend

proposed_blend_manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of the proposed tobacco blend

proposed_blend_source.description: Where the proposed blend originated: user's collection, wishlist, or new entry

temp_tobacco_snapshot.description: JSON snapshot of a temporary/unowned tobacco for this session: {name, manufacturer, blend_family, blend_type, tobacco_components, is_aromatic, aromatic_intensity, casing, topping, cut, strength}. Used when proposed_blend_source is 'new'. Not added to owned inventory.

recommended_pipe_id.description: Pipe ID of the canonical scorer's top recommendation

recommended_pipe_name.description: Display name of the recommended pipe

recommended_bowl_variant_id.description: Bowl variant ID of the recommendation, if applicable

recommended_bowl_name.description: Display name of the recommended bowl variant, if applicable

recommended_score.description: Canonical pairing score (0–10) for the top recommendation

recommended_confidence.description: Confidence level of the recommendation based on scorer diagnostics

recommended_is_best_available.description: True when the recommendation is 'Best Available' rather than 'Best Choice' — e.g., when all present pipes have meaningful conflicts

recommended_why.description: Canonical scorer reasoning for the top recommendation

alternative_pipe_id.description: Pipe ID of the second-best recommendation

alternative_pipe_name.description: Display name of the alternative pipe

alternative_bowl_variant_id.description: Bowl variant ID of the alternative recommendation, if applicable

alternative_bowl_name.description: Bowl name of the alternative recommendation, if applicable

alternative_score.description: Canonical pairing score (0–10) for the alternative pipe

alternative_why.description: Canonical scorer reasoning for the alternative recommendation

actual_pipe_id.description: Pipe ID of the pipe the user actually smoked

actual_pipe_name.description: Display name of the pipe actually smoked

actual_bowl_variant_id.description: Bowl variant ID of the bowl actually used

actual_bowl_name.description: Display name of the bowl actually used

pairing_rating.description: Rating of how well the pipe and tobacco paired (1–5)

would_smoke_again.description: Whether the user would smoke this tobacco again

disposition.description: User's disposition toward the proposed tobacco: wishlist to track it, not_for_me to exclude from future recommendations

wishlist_item_id.description: ID of the AcquisitionItem created when disposition is wishlist

created_by.description: Email of the user who created this record

created_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was created

updated_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was last updated
